turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor: Hello! Sure. Quick recap: third person singular takes -s (works), -es after -sh, -ch, -s, -x and -o (watches, goes), and consonant + y becomes -ies (studies). Let's test the trickier ones first: The baby ___ (cry) at night. Write only the verb.
